messages:
raj: observability just fired a regional alert — pac-north control-plane and routing fabric flapping, large 5xx spike and GPU eviction storm.
infra-bot: Alert: pac-north: control-plane heartbeats missing for 3/4 AZs; 5xx rate >40% | affected services: runtime-proxy, kv-store, gpu-scheduler
olivia: I'm pulling dashboards — any customer reports yet?
mike: getting a handful of error tickets, some timeouts, tail latency up.
sara: doing a quick node/pod health sweep:
```\nkubectl get pods -n runtime --field-selector=status.phase!=Running\nkubectl get nodes -o wide | grep NotReady\n# seeing ~120 NotReady GPU worker nodes in pac-north\n```
raj: ok. priority 1: reduce customer impact. can we shift traffic off pac-north to fallback? prefer us-west-2 + dedicated fallback pool.
carla: propose staged traffic fanout: 20% -> 60% -> 100% with canary checks. need routing policy change + BGP weight updates. @networking please prep.
networking: prepping fanout plan now. will update LB weights and BGP prefixes. ETA 4m for first 20% shift.
mike: also confirm model vvariants available in fallback (smaller memory / quantized) so we don't OOM on alternate infra. I'll pin q4_kvm variants where needed.
olivia: quick cost callout — shifting to us-west-2 dedicated increases cost for affected tokens ~25% while fallback active. FYI.
raj: availability first, cost acceptable. proceed.
sara: running node-drain/evac script on implicated pools now: 
```\n# drain command snippet\npython tools/evacuate_pool.py --region pac-north --pool gpu-pool-7 --mode drain\n```
infra-bot: Evacuation initiated. Draining 48 GPU nodes from pac-north pool. Autoscaler suspended for safety.
networking: first 20% shift live. canaries pinging core endpoints. monitoring for 5xx regressions.
mike: canaries look stable at 20%. no error uptick. recommend move to 60%.
carla: hold on full ramp — need KV-store replication lag <50ms before >60%. current replication lag 120ms.
sara: promoting local replicas and throttling heavy writers, lag trending to 38ms.
carla: ok proceed to 100%.
networking: traffic now fully shifted to us-west-2 + dedicated fallback fleet. pac-north still showing control-plane flaps but customer traffic routed away.
raj: good. next: collect failures, estimate node loss, start replacement plan, and open vendor escalation if HW fault.
mike: preliminary: ~60 nodes had GPU driver panics and auto-evicted, logs are being aggregated to /incidents/2678001110/logs.tar.gz
olivia: opening INC ticket and looping SOC + vendor: :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-458 pac-north fabric collapse. Priority: P1. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2026-458
raj: thanks all. triage complete for initial response. keep updates in this thread with timelines, logs, and next steps. I'll draft customer comms now.
